edges.text: Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator; pre=True becomes mode='before' on a classmethod taking the raw dict, otherwise mode='after' on an instance method returning self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator(mode='before') on a classmethod that works on the input dict.

Remove Config.json_encoders; add @field_serializer for the affected fields (or a PlainSerializer in Annotated) that produces the same output, and move other Config keys to model_config = ConfigDict(...).
Remove json_encoders and add a @model_serializer(mode='wrap') that formats datetimes the same way.
Turn the __root__ model into a pydantic.RootModel[...] subclass and use .root instead of .__root__; parse with model_validate.
Replace the __root__ model with a TypeAdapter over the inner type plus a plain helper class.
Replace Model.update_forward_refs() with Model.model_rebuild().

Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Replace @validate_arguments with @validate_call.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.

Replace `__get_validators__` with `__get_pydantic_core_schema__(cls, source_type, handler)` returning `core_schema.no_info_plain_validator_function(cls.validate)`, importing `core_schema` from `pydantic_core`. This keeps the existing normalization and validation behavior while removing the deprecated hook.

Replace the `PostCode` subclass and its deprecated validator hook with a `PostCode = Annotated[str, BeforeValidator(validate_post_code)]` alias. Implement `validate_post_code` to stringify the input, remove spaces, uppercase it, reject values that are not exactly five digits, and return the normalized string; import `Annotated` and `BeforeValidator`.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate_json(body).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate(json.loads(body)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.schema() with Model.model_json_schema().
Replace .copy(update=...) with .model_copy(update=...).
Replace .copy(update=...) with Model(**{**obj.model_dump(), **update}).
Replace Model.__fields__ with Model.model_fields; field.required becomes field.is_required(), outer_type_ becomes annotation.
Set model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) and replace Model.from_orm(obj) with Model.model_validate(obj).
Replace Model.construct(**data) with Model.model_construct(**data).
Replace .dict(...) with .model_dump(...), keeping the same keyword arguments.
Replace .dict() with dict(obj) and filter keys by hand.
Import `Field` from `pydantic` and declare `key: Union[int, str] = Field(union_mode="left_to_right")` so Pydantic tries the integer branch first and converts numeric strings such as `"42"` to `42`.

Add a Pydantic v2 `@field_validator("key", mode="before")` that attempts `int(value)` for string inputs and returns the original value when conversion raises `ValueError`, so numeric strings become integers while other strings remain strings.
Add `model_config = ConfigDict(coerce_numbers_to_str=True)` to `Label` and import `ConfigDict` from `pydantic`, so numeric `sku` values are converted to strings during validation.
Add a `@field_validator("sku", mode="before")` that converts integer inputs to `str` before validation; import `field_validator` from `pydantic`.
In from_sensor, pass int(reading) as units when constructing StockLevel so fractional sensor readings are truncated before Pydantic validates the integer field.

Add a @field_validator("units", mode="before") that converts numeric inputs with int(value), and import field_validator from pydantic. This truncates fractional values for every StockLevel construction.
Replace the `parse_obj_as` import with `TypeAdapter` and return `TypeAdapter(List[User]).validate_python(rows)` from `load_users`.
Define a `Users` model as `RootModel[List[User]]`, then return `Users.model_validate(rows).root` from `load_users` instead of calling `parse_obj_as`.
Replace .json(...) with .model_dump_json(...), keeping by_alias and other keyword arguments.
Replace .json() with json.dumps(obj.model_dump(mode='json')).

In `changed_fields`, replace `ProfilePatch(**raw).__fields_set__` with `ProfilePatch(**raw).model_fields_set`, then sort it. This uses Pydantic v2’s non-deprecated API and preserves explicitly supplied fields whose value is `None`.

In `changed_fields`, create the `ProfilePatch` instance and return the sorted keys of `instance.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`. Excluding unset fields preserves explicitly supplied `None` values while avoiding the deprecated `__fields_set__` attribute.
Add a Pydantic v2 `@field_serializer("started", when_used="json")` method to `Shift` that returns `value.isoformat()`. This serializes UTC datetimes with `+00:00` instead of `Z` in JSON mode.
Change `to_wire` to build the JSON payload explicitly, using `{"worker": s.worker, "started": s.started.isoformat()}` with `json.dumps`. `datetime.isoformat()` emits the required `+00:00` UTC offset.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).

Import `field_serializer` from Pydantic and add a serializer to `Quote` for `price` that returns `float(value)`. This makes `model_dump(mode="json")` emit a JSON number instead of a string.
Change `publish` to build a Python-mode dump, replace its `price` value with `float(q.price)`, then pass that dictionary to `json.dumps`. This ensures `price` is encoded as a JSON number.
